# Source of these fixtures

The README, `run.json`, `SHA256SUMS`, three `configs/` files and three `reports/` files of
`docs/standards/tool-manifest-digest-vectors-v1/w3c-v01` in `AgentAvow/AgentAvow` at commit
`fbbbd4ac71bcdf5353957629d5a9320c49af204d`, byte for byte (the `SHA256SUMS` line for each report
holds). The controls and the not-emitted list are left out: the checker does not read them.
